_comment_variant: HYDRA Variant C — Brandon Trojan Horse stack with Brandon's narrow 5/10pt spread widths (his actual rule from the interview). Identical Brandon feature stack AND identical narrow_spread widths to variant B (both: 5pt at VIX < 22, 10pt at VIX >= 22). B and C do NOT differ on spread width. The real differences are: a sparser 3-slot morning grid (10:15 / 10:45 / 11:15 vs B's 4 slots 09:45 / 10:45 / 11:15 / 11:45), a tighter concurrency cap (vix_regime.max_entries [2,2,2,1] vs B's [4,4,3,2]), and a looser per-underlying cap (max_contracts_per_underlying 180 vs B's 60). Dry-run for the first 4 weeks. B vs C therefore tests entry cadence / concurrency, NOT spread width.
_comment_credentials: IBKR OAuth credentials are loaded from systemd $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY on the VM, or env vars in dev. Not in this file.

strategy._comment_commission: IBKR all-in SPX cost ~$1.15/leg/contract (~$0.65 IBKR Pro base + ~$0.45 CBOE index fee + ~$0.05 ORF/OCC/CAT) — replaces the Saxo-era $2.50 default. Display/reported-P&L only; does NOT affect entry/stop logic. Critical for C: at 10c × 4 legs × 3 slots, the Saxo-vs-IBKR gap is ~$170-340/day — judging C's dry-run at $2.50 would wrongly book phantom fees. Set 2026-05-29 at the IBKR cutover.
strategy._comment_widths: MKT-027 settings here are unused at runtime — strategy.brandon.narrow_spread.enabled=true overrides _get_vix_adjusted_spread_width with Brandon's 5/10pt rule. Values kept aligned with variant A's VM config (max=75pt) for consistency / debugging clarity.
strategy._comment_put_only_max_vix: Lifted from HYDRA-baseline 15 → 28 because Brandon GEX-ADJ skip-and-route-as-put-only is a core part of his strategy when SPX is inside the call accel zone — capping the fallback at VIX < 15 would block it on most days (VIX 15-25 is normal, not extreme).
strategy._comment_credit_floors: Lowered ~10× vs variants A/B because narrow_spread.enabled=true makes the IC 5pt or 10pt wide instead of 75pt — credits scale roughly proportionally with spread width, so HYDRA's standard $0.20/$0.30 floors would skip every entry.
strategy._comment_safety_caps: ORDER-006 caps raised vs 1c default (10 / 30) to accommodate Brandon narrow-spread sizing. 2026-05-13 cut from 15c → 10c per the same commission-drag review that trimmed B's slot grid: at $2.50/leg × 4 legs × 15c = $150 round-trip per IC, the wins-to-fees ratio on B/C from 5/4-5/12 was unfavorable. Worst-case open contracts on SPX is bounded by vix_regime.max_entries (peak 2, below) not by entry_times count: 10c × 2 concurrent ICs × 4 legs = 80 counted contracts (_get_current_position_size adds contracts_per_entry per open leg; one full IC = 40). The 180 per-underlying cap is intentionally looser than B's 60 — B (max_entries peak 4) is deliberately throttled to ~1.5 ICs to share the margin pool, whereas C (max_entries peak 2) is left with headroom above its 80-contract ceiling. 15 per-order cap leaves headroom for size adjustments without disabling the bug-protection check entirely.
strategy._comment_min_bp_per_ic: ORDER-004 BP-per-contract floor lowered $5000 → $500 because narrow 5pt × $100 = $500/contract margin (Brandon narrow-spread economics). Default is sized for wide HYDRA-baseline; without this override, every entry trips required vs available — same bug pattern as MAX_CONTRACTS_PER_ORDER yesterday.
strategy._comment_pnl_bounds: DATA-003 sanity bounds scaled for narrow-spread × 10c (2026-05-13 cut from 15c). Multiplied by contracts at runtime: max_pnl_per_ic 100 × 10c = $1000 ceiling, min_pnl_per_ic -1000 × 10c = -$10,000 floor. Default -3000 floor would falsely flag real drawdowns as 'impossible' and skip stop checks.
strategy._comment_downday_callonly: OFF on C — Brandon GEX adjuster is the sole side-selection logic on the Brandon stack; HYDRA's down-day call-only override would conflict with GEX zone reads.
strategy._comment_e6_removed_AUD2-M5: Variant C used to declare conditional_entry_times: ['14:00'] but every conditional_*_e6_enabled flag was false. AUD2-M5 (2026-05-24) audit found this inconsistency — the 14:00 slot was being consumed by vix_regime.max_entries cap accounting without ever firing. Removed for clarity. C is now a strict 3-slot morning grid (10:15 / 10:45 / 11:15) — Brandon-faithful baseline.
strategy._comment_conditional_directional: OFF on C — directional bias (down-day put-only at 14:00 / up-day put-only at 14:00) is HYDRA's heuristic. Brandon GEX adjuster already makes the side-selection call from gamma zones; layering both produces conflicting signals on mixed days.

vix_regime._comment_min_credits: Per-VIX-zone credit gates also lowered ~10× because narrow 5/10pt spreads collect $0.05-$0.20 typical at 8-delta vs A/B's $1.00-$2.00 on 75pt-wide spreads. Without this scaling, MKT-011 skips every C entry by design (verified live 2026-05-05 10:45: C reported call $0.08 / put $0.02 vs A/B's $1.15 / $1.23 on the same chain).

directional_pivot._comment: Disabled in variant C — Brandon GEX-breach exit (shadow) plays the same role.

brandon._comment: Identical Brandon stack to variant B, INCLUDING narrow_spread (both variants set enabled=true, breakpoint_vix=22.0, width_low=5, width_high=10 — they do NOT differ on spread width). Per Brandon: 5pt at VIX < 22, 10pt at VIX >= 22 (plus a 25pt safety ceiling). All Brandon features are fully LIVE (TP / strike adjuster / breach exit / overlay). Only shadow behavior is hydra_stop_shadow — same as variant B. B vs C differs only at the top-level config (entry_times, vix_regime.max_entries, max_contracts_per_underlying), not inside this brandon block.
brandon._comment_disable_tightening: Same rationale as variant B: HYDRA's MKT-020/MKT-022 tighteners chase credit by walking strikes toward ATM, which clashes with Brandon's GEX-zone strike selection. C's E#2 on 2026-05-07 was tightened from 125pt OTM to 25pt OTM (P:7340) right on the 7330 wall — when the wall broke, the breach close cost was $2,925 vs the recorded $0. Disabled here so Brandon GEX-ADJ is the sole strike-selection mechanism.
brandon._comment_delta_target: Same Brandon-faithful delta-target strike selection as variant B. 8δ short anchored to Polygon's option chain (strategy.target_delta=8 above), with Brandon GEX-ADJ stacked on top to skip accel-zone sides.

hydra_stop_shadow._comment: When true, computes HYDRA's existing credit+buffer stop every tick in parallel without acting. First fire per side per day is Telegrammed for head-to-head comparison against Brandon's GEX breach (which IS the live stop in B/C).

external_price_feed._comment: Yahoo Finance fallback for VIX/SPX when Saxo returns NoAccess. shared/config_loader.py defaults enabled=false in cloud — explicit override here because Saxo's VIX feed flaps NoAccess every 10-15 sec on FullTradingAndChat session contention.

google_sheets._comment: Top-level google_sheets block — schema GoogleSheetsLogger.__init__ actually reads. The logging.* keys are read by LocalFileLogger and a few other consumers, but Sheets-specific config lives here. Mirrors variant A's block, only spreadsheet_name differs.
